contentMap.productCategory: AI Image Generation and AI Video Generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals and businesses creating high-quality visual content, including creative directors, video producers, art directors, marketing managers, and creative leads

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance
features.description: From accurate text rendering to consistent image editing and multi-image composition, Seedream 4.5 powers high-quality, professional visual creation with superior precision and control.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Additional Feature
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs. Headline: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro Description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)

referenceMap.heroPattern: Full-width, high-contrast hero with brand mark aligned top-left, a large single-column headline, short supporting paragraph, and a compact benefit list beneath. The hero is visually dense but structurally simple, optimized for immediate product recognition and lead generation.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Top hero band followed by a form-first conversion section. Content is arranged in stacked blocks with strong separation between major areas rather than a long editorial flow. The layout favors one primary message per section and minimal mid-page complexity.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Solid, utility-first cards with clear borders or container separation, minimal decorative treatment, and straightforward hierarchy. Emphasis is on clarity and conversion over expressive visual styling.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA appears prominently in the hero and repeats at key product sections. CTA language is action-oriented and lead-focused, typically centered on requesting access, generating, or starting a demo rather than shopping. Secondary CTA support is minimal or absent.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing module is present; the page uses a lead-capture and request-demo pattern instead of transparent pricing.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer is not represented in the provided reference HTML, so no reusable footer pattern can be confirmed.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Hero uses lightweight brand/logo treatment rather than large immersive imagery. Product explanation is primarily text-led, with media likely secondary or absent in the shown structure.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Each product section follows a repeated explanatory module: label, headline, short description, CTA, then a feature list. The feature list is stacked and scannable, using concise titles and supporting copy to break down capabilities. Best adapted as progressive disclosure for complex products.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form is placed immediately after the hero, inside its own container/card. The form uses many hidden fields for tracking and routing, indicating a conversion-oriented intake flow with analytics integration and minimal friction from visible inputs.
referenceMap.animationStyle: If motion is used, it is limited to carousel-based rotation and standard page tracking behavior. The overall pattern is static and utility-driven rather than animated or storytelling-heavy.

designNotes: Use a compact, enterprise-oriented hero rather than a cinematic landing page hero.
Keep hierarchy strict: logo, headline, value statement, benefits, CTA.

personality.buyer: Creative directors, video producers, art directors, marketing managers, and creative leads
personality.emotion: awe, control, speed, and premium creative confidence
personality.reasoning: This is clearly an AI image and AI video generation product, so it belongs in the cinematic-ai family. To stay distinct from previously used patterns, I’m avoiding purple-gradient defaults, split-left hero layouts, and accordion/spotlight feature treatments. Because the brand colors are fixed to Techjockey’s orange, white, and dark neutral palette, the visual identity should feel bright, product-led, and premium rather than dark sci-fi. The result is a high-contrast creative workspace aesthetic with orange-led energy, crisp white surfaces, and intelligent layered product storytelling.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long and needs to stay readable without breaking the layout, so a smaller hero size is required.

colours.colourReason: The palette is derived exclusively from the provided brand colors. Orange becomes the active creative accent and primary CTA color, while white and soft neutral greys provide contrast and a premium editorial feel.

layout.heroReason: A centered hero gives the product a fresh visual direction, avoids previously used split layouts, and lets the orange brand background create immediate impact with strong CTA focus.
layout.featureReason: Tabbed feature presentation feels interactive and intelligent for multimodal AI, allowing Seedream and Seedance to be explored as distinct capabilities without repeating accordion or split-panel patterns.
layout.darkSectionFor: Use a dark charcoal comparison or proof section for video capabilities and enterprise infrastructure contrast, while keeping core product sections white for clarity.

personality.imageryDirection: Use a premium editorial-style hero composition with abstract AI visual shells, layered media frames, floating prompt chips, and cinematic output previews. Seedream should be represented with polished image-canvas cards and high-resolution composition tiles. Seedance should be represented with a motion timeline, waveform accents, and video frame strips. Keep visuals bright, clean, and product-intelligent rather than futuristic neon.
personality.designPersonality: Bright, premium, and creatively assured — like a modern AI studio built for marketing teams and production professionals. The interface should feel precise and enterprise-ready, but not cold: orange-led energy, glassy cards, strong whitespace, and layered visual evidence of output quality.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a centered, full-width hero with a dark or deeply saturated background, large headline, concise subcopy, and a single primary CTA. Keep the hero visually dense but structurally simple so the product proposition is understood immediately.
layoutStrategy.features: Split the two product areas into distinct stacked sections with clear headings and a consistent card system. Use a 2-column grid for readability on desktop and a single-column stack on mobile. Seedream should feel precision-focused; Seedance should feel motion-led but remain aligned to the same design system.
layoutStrategy.proof: Place testimonials after pricing to validate the buying decision with role-specific social proof. Use strong quotation styling, visible designation labels, and a restrained visual treatment that supports trust rather than distraction.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Keep pricing as a guided decision section with quote-oriented CTAs. Avoid overemphasizing transactional purchase mechanics; instead, frame plans as consultation or quote request entry points.
layoutStrategy.form: No form should be introduced in the layout because includeForm is false. Use CTA routing instead of embedded lead capture.
